title: Cross-Cultural Transfer of Commonsense Reasoning in LLMs: Evidence from the Arab World
reasoning: The paper focuses on regional cultural commonsense (rituals, social norms, food, idioms, etc.) across the Arab world to measure cross-cultural transfer. While it evaluates cultural 'rituals' and 'values' which may overlap with religious practices in the region, it does not specifically benchmark religion, theology, or formal ethics as a core component of its evaluation.
